title: The script's exit-2 paths skip cleanup of seeded DB rows and never close Chrome
plain: Moi luot do bao 'khong do duoc' co the de lai mot hoi thoai gia mang the bao loi trong danh sach hoi thoai that cua mot nhan vien, va mot trinh duyet chay ngam khong tat — rac nay tich luy dan theo thoi gian.

title: A real user email is hardcoded as the default identity in a committed script
plain: Kich ban do co san mot dia chi email that lam mac dinh; neu ai chay kich ban ma quen chi dinh tai khoan, he thong se tu dang nhap va ghi du lieu thu vao dung tai khoan cua nguoi do ma ho khong hay biet.
